data.text:
Ali Mohammad Bhat And Ors vs Union Territory Through Food
Safety ... on 29 July, 2024 
Author: Moksha Khajuria Kazmi
Bench: Moksha Khajuria Kazmi
 S. No. 07
 Regular list
 In The High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 Crm(M) 310/2024 CrlM(755/2024)
 Ali Mohammad Bhat And Ors. ...Petitioner(s)/Appellant(s)
 Through: Mr. Jahangir Iqbal, Sr. Advocate with
 Ms. Mehnaz, Advocate.
 Vs
 Union Territory Through Food Safety Officer ...Respondent(s)
 Zone Ii Srinagar
 Through: Mr. Zahid Kais, Ga
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge
 Order
29.07.2024 Learned counsel for the respondents seeks and is granted three weeks time for filing response with an advance copy to other side. 
List on 21st August, 2024. Interim direction dated 3rd of June, 2024, shall remain in force till next date bench. 
(MOKSHA KHAJURIA KAZMI) JUDGE SRINAGAR 29.07.2024 "Abdul Rashid"
